messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Good, mobile data is now enabled. Since you're abroad in France, you also need to enable data roaming on your phone to use mobile data outside your home network. Please use the `toggle_roaming` action on your phone to turn data roaming ON.

After you've done that, let me know and we'll proceed with the next steps. Don't worry - the steps we're doing to improve your data connection won't affect your photos or any other data on your phone.

I have turned on data roaming, but I still have poor signal and I'm connected to a 2G network, with data saver on too. What should I do next to get excellent internet speed? Will changing the network mode help? I'm worried it might cause issues with my photos or other data.

Please discuss the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
